content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

Selling plugins without a payment processor involves leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure to facilitate transactions directly. This approach empowers creators to maintain full ownership of their digital products and revenue streams. Unlike traditional platforms that impose geographic restrictions, this model democratizes access to global markets. It is a permanent structural alternative that eliminates the uncertainty and limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe or PayPal, ensuring that creators can thrive regardless of their location.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this infrastructure uses a combination of free hosting services, backend logic platforms, and automatic payment processors. For instance, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script run the necessary backend logic. Order storage can be handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery can occur via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The integration with NOWPayments allows for seamless crypto payment processing, ensuring instant transaction verification without the need for traditional payment accounts.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Artists, educators, and developers in these areas can sell ebooks, courses, plugins, and more without the fear of being locked out by payment processors. The focus is on enabling creators to retain control over their financial transactions and data, fostering independence and sustainability in their ventures.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate dependency on restrictive platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce infrastructure comprises several key components: a free hosting service (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend logic processor (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), an order database (Supabase or Google Sheets), and a file delivery mechanism (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). When these elements are integrated with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, they create a cohesive ecosystem that supports the entire sales process from product listing to payment confirmation, ensuring reliability and efficiency without ongoing costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin selling plugins without a payment processor, start by setting up a free hosting account on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create the necessary backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, then decide on a delivery method using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for your digital products. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, allowing you to sell directly to your customers without relying on traditional payment systems.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Establish a self-sufficient online store in less than 48 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

You can sell digital products using sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to create an online store with free hosting and cryptocurrency payment processing, eliminating the need for Stripe.

Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?
In many cases, PayPal services are limited or entirely unavailable in these countries, making it essential to explore alternative payment solutions like cryptocurrency through NOWPayments.

The primary fee involves a 0.5% charge from NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, which is significantly lower compared to traditional payment processors.
